LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Caretta.label: Caretta
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Caretta.description: A derivative of the Geochelone serving as a mobile indirect-fire support platform, providing infantry with immediate artillery support. It carries a 2B9 Vasilek mortar as its main weapon and retains the chassis's original miniaturized shipboard shield system.
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Caretta.tools.head.label: head
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Geochelone.label: geochelone
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Geochelone.description: An unmanned all-terrain tracked pulse shield support platform, fitted with a miniaturized shipboard shield system to ward off attacks. It comes in many production models and variants.
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Geochelone.tools.head.label: head
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Killdozer.label: killdozer
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Killdozer.description: A heavy unmanned assault breaching vehicle with a dozer blade up front for breakthroughs and strengthened armor all over the hull; it is even larger than the Geochelone it was based on.
